general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS ROBERT MILLER. THAT’S WHAT’S ON MY DOCUMENTS.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s that I’ve lost interest in things I used to enjoy, and I’m tired a lot. I’ve also been pulling back from people more than I used to, and sleep has been a bit of a mess getting started. It’s… well, it’s been going on for a few months now.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again, really. Stay active too, if I can—keep myself going rather than just sort of fading into the background.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: It’s the 25/100 mg tablets. One tablet, three times a day.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2024.; Side Effects: Just some occasional nausea, nothing else really.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes, another one... latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2021.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes — allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed at age 9.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly.; Duration: I don’t know exactly—just minimal, and that’s about all I can say.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: Bachelor’s degree — I was a teacher.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and grew up… just sort of ordinary, really. Nothing special I can think of there. My childhood feels a bit fuzzy when I try to lay it all out.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School mostly, and then becoming a teacher. That’s the main thing I remember clearly.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Married, and it’s been 49 years. My wife is very supportive.
personal_history.future_goals: Just to enjoy life and manage the illness as best I can.
